# UX, Accessibility & Preservation Checklist: Vault Workbench Redesign

**Purpose**: Validate that the redesign's requirements are complete, unambiguous, consistent and
measurable — **before** implementation starts, while a gap is still a text edit rather than a
rebuilt component.
**Created**: 2026-09-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · handoff `design_handoff_vault_workbench/README.md`

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Scope**: UX & design fidelity, behaviour preservation, accessibility, copy fidelity.
**Depth**: Standard. **Timing**: gate on the spec, before step 1 of the work order.

---

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the row summary line defined for a secret whose template has **no non-sensitive field**? The summary is specified as `template.name · folderName · <first non-sensitive field value>`, but the built-in Secure Note has exactly one field and it is `sensitive: true`. [Gap, Handoff §2.3]
- [ ] CHK002 Is quick-copy behaviour defined for a row whose secret has **no sensitive field**? The control is specified as copying "the first sensitive field". [Gap, Handoff §2.3]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the decrypting/loading state specified for the three-pane layout? Today a single `Decrypting…` line replaces the whole list; where it belongs when list and detail are separate panes is not stated. [Gap, `SecretList.tsx:342`]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the rail's folder and tag sections specified for a vault that has neither? Whether an empty section renders its label, a hint, or nothing at all is undefined. [Gap, Handoff §2.1]
- [ ] CHK005 Is selection behaviour on **vault switch** specified? The spec defines selection surviving search and filter changes, but not what happens when the underlying vault changes. [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the edit flow fully specified — where `TemplateForm` renders, what replaces the detail pane while editing, and what Cancel returns to? The concurrency error is placed "above the form" in the detail pane, implying inline, but the flow is not described. [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK007 Are layout requirements defined for viewports **between the phone breakpoint (640px) and roughly 900px**? Rail (262px) and list (352px) are fixed, so the detail pane is squeezed to near-zero in that band. Only ≤640px and full width are drawn. [Gap, Handoff §2, §4]
- [ ] CHK008 With the sort control cut, is the count line's layout respecified? It was specified as a two-sided row with sort on the right. [Gap, Spec §FR-030a, Handoff §2.3]
- [ ] CHK009 Are requirements defined for which notices are dismissible, and whether a dismissed notice returns on reload or on the next session? "a dismiss `x` where the current markup allows dismissal" defers the question rather than answering it. [Ambiguity, Handoff §2.2]
- [ ] CHK010 Are requirements stated for what happens to the detail pane while a **rotation** is re-encrypting the vault the selected secret lives in? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK011 Is the avatar initial defined for titles that do not begin with a Latin letter — an emoji, a digit, a space, or a non-Latin script? "first letter of the title" assumes one. [Clarity, Handoff §2.3]
- [ ] CHK012 Are truncation rules specified when the three parts of the summary line compete for a fixed 352px column — which part truncates first, and is any part allowed to disappear? [Clarity, Handoff §2.3]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the format of "{relative updated}" in the detail footer specified (thresholds, wording, and behaviour for "just now" and for dates older than a week)? [Clarity, Handoff §2.4]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "Recently used" fully removed from all requirements, or does the scope row still appear in prose that implementation might follow? [Consistency, Spec §FR-030a]
- [ ] CHK015 Is the countdown's display specified for edge values — under one minute, at zero, and if the deadline is already past due to clock adjustment or a suspended tab? [Clarity, Gap, Handoff §2.1]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK016 Do the icon-button size requirements conflict? The detail pane specifies 32px round buttons; the accessibility requirement demands ≥44px targets at narrow widths. Is it stated which wins, and at what breakpoint? [Conflict, Handoff §2.4 vs Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the tag chip treatment consistent between the rail (on/off filter states) and the detail pane (outline, non-interactive display)? Both are called "chips" with different specified appearances. [Consistency, Handoff §2.1, §2.4]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the "no red" rule consistent with the destructive vocabulary? `--danger` is aliased to `--color-accent-700`, which is also the colour of the type chip and ordinary links — is it stated how destructive intent is distinguished when the colour is shared? [Consistency, Handoff §Design tokens]
- [ ] CHK019 Do the spec's preserved-behaviour list and the handoff's "Interactions & behaviour" section agree item for item, with no behaviour named in one and absent from the other? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001..FR-012]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK020 Is SC-001 objectively verifiable? "24 secrets scannable without scrolling" needs a stated viewport **and** a row height budget; without the latter it cannot be checked before the layout exists. [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK021 Can "the list is scannable" be assessed by anything other than opinion — is there a stated criterion beyond the row count fitting? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK022 Is SC-005 ("every string traceable") backed by an enumerable source list, so that tracing is a finite check rather than a judgement? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Accessibility Requirements

- [ ] CHK023 Is a colour-contrast requirement stated for the **token set as a whole**, rather than for the single pair the handoff asserts? Two specified pairs appear to fall below 4.5:1 — see Notes. [Gap, Handoff §Design tokens]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the keyboard model for the secret list specified — are rows links, buttons, or a listbox; does focus move row-by-row with arrows or tab through all 24? [Gap, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK025 Is focus order across the three panes specified, including where focus lands after selecting a row and after closing the detail pane on a phone? [Gap, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the countdown chip's announcement politeness specified? A timer updating every second in an assertive live region would make the page unusable with a screen reader. [Gap, Handoff §2.1]
- [ ] CHK027 Is it specified whether the `/` keyboard badge is exposed to assistive technology or hidden from it? [Gap, Handoff §2.3]
- [ ] CHK028 Are `prefers-reduced-motion` requirements stated? Transitions are specified at 120ms with no reduced-motion exception. [Gap, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the ≥44px target requirement stated as a **measured** criterion rather than a stylesheet rule? The current stylesheet sets 36px and no test has ever measured it. [Measurability, Spec §FR-027, Research §8]

## Copy & Content Fidelity

- [ ] CHK030 Is the set of **permitted** copy changes enumerated? "Keep copy verbatim" is absolute, yet the design changes the search placeholder, abbreviates the search privacy sentence, and adds several new strings. Without a list, "verbatim" cannot be checked. [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK031 Are the new strings the design introduces individually sourced and approved — "— narrow together", "· searched on this device", "Locks in mm:ss", "Choose a secret to see its fields."? [Traceability, Handoff §2.1–2.4]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the destination of the full privacy sentence specified? Today's *"Runs entirely on this device — the server cannot read your titles, so it cannot search them."* is replaced by a four-word suffix; whether the explanation moves elsewhere or is dropped is a content decision that is not recorded. [Gap, `SearchBar.tsx:76`]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the product name in the rail's brand row resolved? The handoff shows *"Keyhouse"* with "(or the product name)"; the application is titled "Password Manager". Introducing a brand name is a copy change, not a visual one. [Conflict, Handoff §2.1]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK034 Is the assumption that both typefaces may be self-hosted validated against their licences, and is including the licence files stated as a requirement? [Assumption, Research §2]
- [ ] CHK035 Are all ~30 named Lucide icons confirmed to exist under those names in the pinned version, rather than assumed? [Assumption, Handoff §Assets]
- [ ] CHK036 Is FR-031 ("fonts available without a network request") stated in terms that can be verified — i.e. naming the precache requirement, not only the outcome? [Clarity, Spec §FR-031]

## Notes

### Two contrast pairs appear to fail WCAG AA (relates to CHK023)

Computed from the token values in the handoff, using the standard relative-luminance formula.
These want confirming with the design's author before implementation, because both are specified
in the design rather than being implementation choices:

| Pair | Ratio | Needs | |
|---|---|---|---|
| White on `--color-accent` `#c67139` — the primary button, specified at **15px** | **3.61:1** | 4.5:1 | ✗ |
| `--color-neutral-600` `#82796a` on `--color-bg` `#f5ead8` — section labels at **11.5px** | **3.61:1** | 4.5:1 | ✗ |
| `--color-accent-700` on `--color-bg` — the one pair the handoff asserts | 5.72:1 | 4.5:1 | ✓ |
| `--color-accent-700` on `--color-accent-200` — type chip | 5.49:1 | 4.5:1 | ✓ |
| `--color-accent-2-800` on `--color-accent-2-200` — folder chip | 8.11:1 | 4.5:1 | ✓ |
| `--color-neutral-700` on `--color-neutral-100` — meta text | 6.02:1 | 4.5:1 | ✓ |

Neither failing pair qualifies for the 3:1 large-text allowance: Caprasimo ships at weight 400, so
15px is normal text, and 11.5px is far below the threshold at any weight.

This is a **requirements** problem, not an implementation one: the handoff asserts a contrast
guarantee for exactly one pair and is silent on the rest, so an implementer following it faithfully
would ship both failures. Resolving it needs either a darker accent for button text, larger text,
or an explicit documented exception.

### The most likely thing to bite during implementation

CHK001 and CHK002 are the same shape of gap and both are reachable in the first hour of building
the list: **Secure Note has one field and it is sensitive**, so it has no non-sensitive value for
the summary line and no second field to fall back to. Whatever is decided there also answers what
a row looks like for a secret whose fields are all empty.

### Items intentionally not included

Nothing here re-checks a decision already recorded in the spec's "Decisions taken" — the cuts to
"Recently used", rotation progress, the member count and dark mode are settled, not open. CHK014
is the exception, and it checks only that the cut is reflected consistently in the prose.
